summary.bn: মাপার ভোল্টেজকে ৫ ভাগের ১ ভাগ করে S পিনে দেয়।
summary.en: Gives a fifth of the voltage it measures on its S pin.

simplified: The module is two resistors, 30 kΩ and 7.5 kΩ, as sellers describe it; the lab takes them as exact. Real ones are within a few percent.

On the real module the voltage to measure goes to a screw terminal (VCC, GND) and the board reads S and − on a three-pin header, whose + pin is not connected. The lab puts the three legs that matter in a row.
It is rated for 25 V; the lab warns above that. On a board that reads up to 3.3 V, S reaches its limit at 16.5 V.
